components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Flat ocean-blue action for Search, Apply and refresh.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0.44rem 1.15rem; min-height: 2.9rem; font: 600 1rem/1.5 "DM Sans", sans-serif; box-shadow: none; } .ds-button-primary:hover, .ds-button-primary:active { background: var(--accent-deep); border-color: var(--accent-deep); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: White search input with the site's body face and visible focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-label" for="ds-search">Search articles</label><input class="ds-search-input" id="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="Search articles">
components.css: .ds-search-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; color: var(--ink); font: 600 0.84rem/1.2 "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 2.9rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); color: var(--ink); background: #fff; font: 400 0.95rem/1.5 "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Control
components.description: Anchored multi-select trigger with a crisp CSS chevron.
components.css: .ds-filter-control { min-height: 2.55rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); color: var(--ink); background: #fff; font: 600 0.84rem/1.2 "DM Sans", sans-serif; box-shadow: none; } .ds-filter-control::after { display: inline-block; width: 0.45rem; height: 0.45rem; margin-left: 0.7rem; border: solid currentColor; border-width: 0 1.5px 1.5px 0; content: ""; transform: translateY(-0.12rem) rotate(45deg); } .ds-filter-control:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-deep); } .ds-filter-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Feed Navigation
components.description: Dynamic, Newest and Popular tabs with a clear current state.
components.html: DynamicNewestPopular
components.css: .ds-feed-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.2rem; padding: 0.2rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.55rem; background: var(--page); } .ds-feed-tabs a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.1rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 0.3rem; color: var(--muted); font: 600 0.83rem/1.5 "DM Sans", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-feed-tabs a:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-feed-tabs a[aria-current="page"] { color: #fff; background: var(--accent); } .ds-feed-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-article-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: #fff; box-shadow: none; } .ds-article-link { display: flex; min-height: 17rem; flex-direction: column; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-cover { flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 7.5rem; background: var(--surface-muted); } .ds-card-content { padding: 0.9rem 1rem 1rem; } .ds-category { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; color: var(--accent); font: 700 0.68rem/1.3 "DM Sans", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.075em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-title { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); font: 700 1.04rem/1.28 "Manrope", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-source { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 0.6rem; margin: 0.7rem 0 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 0.78rem/1.35 "DM Sans", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-source span { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; } .ds-article-card:hover { border-color: #aab8c0; } .ds-article-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -4px; }

narrative.northStar: A Game Library for Independent Writing
narrative.overview:
Reconnect presents independent games writing as a changing collection of publication covers. The interface is editorial rather than retail: cover art helps readers recognize a story, while its title, publication and date remain the information used to scan and choose what to read.

The visual language is calm and catalogue-like. Cool paper tones, restrained blue actions, clean rules and confident sans typography give varied sources a shared frame without making the site feel like a storefront or social network.
keyCharacteristics: Cover-led discovery with clear article attribution.
Equal-width cards whose image area and height vary by size.
Quiet, bordered surfaces instead of elevated or decorative panels.
Column-first feed flow that keeps visual order aligned with keyboard order.

rules.name: The Cover-First Rule
rules.body: Use cover art to signal an article's subject, but keep its title, publication and date legible.

rules.name: The Grid-Unit Rule
rules.body: Card sizes are whole multiples of one small cell; never use arbitrary heights or widths.

dos: Do use real publication cover art as the visual entry point; keep the title, publication and date legible.
Do size cards in whole grid cells: 1x1, 1x2 or 2x2.
Do use ocean blue for primary actions and the selected feed.
Do use a calm placeholder when a cover is missing or fails to load.
donts: Don't turn the feed into a storefront or social network.
Don't add large shadows beneath bordered cards and controls.
Don't give a text-only or broken-image article a medium or large size.
Don't invent readership figures, testimonials or publication claims.
